interface.shortDescription: Influencer audit: audience quality and engagement rate checks
interface.longDescription: Influencer audit and influencer vetting before you pay a creator. Get an audience quality check with the signals behind it, an engagement rate check against accounts of the same size, posting cadence and an estimated sponsored-post rate; compare finalists side by side; find creators by niche, size and country; keep shortlists for your influencer marketing campaigns. Uses your Followproof plan's allowance.
interface.defaultPrompt: Is @nasa's Instagram audience real, and what would a sponsored post cost?
